cases.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: benchmark app icon
Primary request: Create a simple square icon for an open-source token-economy toolkit: one abstract coin combined with a small spark, centered.
Style/medium: crisp flat vector-like raster illustration
Composition/framing: centered symbol, generous padding, readable at 64 px
Color palette: navy, cyan, and warm gold on an off-white background
Constraints: no text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no mockup frame

Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: desktop web dashboard benchmark mockup
Primary request: Create a polished desktop dashboard for tracking AI model token economics.
Scene/backdrop: full browser-page canvas, no device frame
Style/medium: high-fidelity modern SaaS UI mockup
Composition/framing: 16:10 landscape; left navigation, top summary cards, central model-comparison table, compact usage trend chart
Color palette: warm off-white canvas, navy text, cyan accents, restrained gold highlights
Text (verbatim): "Token Economy", "Models", "Usage", "Cost", "Evidence"
Constraints: clear information hierarchy, plausible values, accessible contrast, no external brand logos, no watermark
checks: dashboard hierarchy and requested regions are visible

cases.prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram
Asset type: architecture diagram benchmark
Primary request: Create a clean architecture diagram showing a repository-owned capability catalog pulled by two consumers.
Style/medium: polished technical infographic, flat 2D
Composition/framing: 16:10 landscape; left-to-right flow with three tiers
Text (verbatim): "Evidence Sources", "Media Capability Catalog", "Agent Studio", "Reporting Job", "embedded JSON", "pull"
Color palette: off-white background, navy components, cyan connectors, gold evidence markers
Constraints: exactly one central catalog, arrows from evidence sources into catalog, arrows labeled "pull" from catalog to both consumers, highly legible labels, no vendor logos, no watermark
checks: one central catalog and two consumers are visible
required labels and pull arrows are legible

cases.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: photo-style benchmark image
Primary request: A candid editorial photograph of a software engineer at a wooden desk reviewing colorful architecture sketches beside a laptop.
Scene/backdrop: quiet daylight studio with a softly blurred bookshelf
Style/medium: natural photorealistic editorial photography
Composition/framing: horizontal waist-up scene, 35 mm lens, subject slightly left of center, sketches visible in foreground
Lighting/mood: soft window light, calm focused mood, realistic skin and paper textures
Color palette: warm wood, off-white paper, subtle cyan and gold sketch accents
Constraints: natural hands, physically plausible workspace, no readable brand logos, no watermark, no on-image text
checks: engineer, laptop, and architecture sketches are visible
photo-style lighting and textures are plausible
